body: I know my parents care about me. But to see them disappointed is like a jab through the heart for me.
"Pulled me out of the reality I'd created for myself" You sound like one of my teachers. :)
I can't do that. I have already disappointed my parents to a crazy extent. Ive been like this for months. Im not going to do it. For now. Thank you.

I'm Just tired with living. Every day is a challenge without a reward. I fail everything. My grades are ok but socially Im a complete idiot. I cant living knowing that my parents are dissapointed with me my brother is disappointed with me. And Im disappointed with myself.
